decisions.reason: As a specialized industrial piping component that survived the initial launch period and fits a metal fabricator’s core capabilities, it is more likely to be retained as a niche catalogue item.
A powder-coated public waste bin is a standard fabricated metal product with broad municipal and commercial use, so the firm would likely keep it unless sales were clearly weak.
The waste bin with ashtray still fits the firm’s fabrication and coating skills, but its more specific use case makes it somewhat more at risk than a basic waste bin.
A standalone outdoor public ashtray is the narrowest and most substitution-prone item in the 2019 line, so management would be relatively likely to discontinue it and focus resources elsewhere.
